narr: Deep monsoon moisture remained over northern Arizona with heavy rain producing thunderstorms.
ev: Flash flooding was reported in the Tse Bonito Wash and across State Route 264 in Window Rock.
Heavy rain fell over the Pipeline Fire scar (June 2022) and caused flooding in Wupatki Trails and into Cinder Lakes and closed Highway 89 about a mile north of the neighborhood.
